name: Proofwp – Visual Product Reviews for WooCommerce
author: Debuggers Studio

sections.description:
ProofWP is a powerful WooCommerce review plugin designed to help store owners collect customer photo reviews, video reviews, star ratings, and UGC to increase trust and boost conversions.

Automatically send review request emails after order purchase or delivery, collect authentic customer feedback, and display visual product reviews, testimonial sliders, trust badges, and social proof sections anywhere on your WooCommerce store.

With ProofWP, you can showcase real customer experiences using photo and video testimonials, helping shoppers build confidence before purchasing.

Live Demo | Documentation | Upgrade to Pro

Why ProofWP?

In fact, 93% of buyers read reviews before making a purchase. The problem is that most WooCommerce stores display plain, boring text reviews that nobody notices. Proofwp changes that.

When shoppers see real photos, videos, and star ratings from other customers, they buy faster and with more confidence. That is social proof and ProofWP makes it easy to collect and display it across your entire WooCommerce store.

Unlike hosted review platforms, your reviews live in your own WordPress database. No third-party lock-in. Your customer data stays yours, always accessible and fully under your control.

More reviews. More trust. More sales. Collect photo & video reviews, star ratings, and UGC for your WooCommerce store.

What Can You Do With ProofWP?

Collect Photo & Video Reviews

Automatically send review request emails after purchase. Customers can upload real photos and videos directly from the email — no account needed, no friction.

Display Star Ratings & Review Feeds

Show product ratings, review summaries, and full review feeds anywhere on your store using simple drag-and-drop widgets. Works with any WooCommerce theme.

Show Real-Time Social Proof Notifications

Display live purchase and review activity popups across your store to create urgency and encourage visitors to act before they leave.

Add Trust Badges & Proof Widgets

Place product ratings and trust badges on product pages, cart pages, and checkout screens to reduce hesitation and improve buying confidence.

Import Reviews From Other Platforms

Already collecting reviews elsewhere? Import them into ProofWP and start showcasing social proof immediately, not starting from zero.

Automated Post-Purchase Review Requests

Set it once and let ProofWP handle the rest. Review request emails go out automatically after every order so you never have to chase customers manually.

Customer Photo & Video Review Features for WooCommerce

  • Grid Review Layout – Display customer reviews in a clean and responsive grid style.
  • Review Slider Layout – Showcase reviews in an interactive slider carousel.
  • Stack Slider Layout (Pro) – Display stacked review cards with modern sliding effects.
  • Accordion Review Slider (Pro) – Create expandable accordion-style testimonial sliders.
  • Marquee Review Layout (Pro) – Show continuously scrolling customer reviews and testimonials.
  • Video Review Playback – Play customer video testimonials directly inside review widgets.
  • Video Autoplay Support – Automatically play video reviews within sliders and carousels.
  • UGC Review Support – Let customers upload photo and video reviews to create authentic social proof.
  • Review Testimonial Widgets – Create beautiful testimonial and social proof sections.
  • Mobile Responsive Widgets – Ensure review sliders work perfectly on all devices.
  • Border & Color Customization – Customize colors, borders, spacing, fonts, and star ratings to match your WooCommerce store design.
  • Review Widget Shortcodes – Embed review widgets anywhere using simple shortcodes.
  • WooCommerce Integration – Seamlessly integrate review widgets with WooCommerce products.
  • Easy Review Management Dashboard – Manage reviews, widgets, and settings from one place.
  • Post Purchase Review Emails – Automatically send review request emails after WooCommerce product purchases or deliveries.
  • Follow-up Review Emails (Pro) – Send automated follow-up emails to collect more customer reviews and feedback.
  • Elementor, Block & Classic Theme Support – Works seamlessly with Elementor, Gutenberg block themes, and classic WordPress themes.

Build Instructions

This plugin uses modern JavaScript (React and TypeScript) and requires a build step to generate production-ready files in the dist/ directory.

  1. Ensure Node.js (version 22 or higher) and npm are installed.

  2. Navigate to the plugin directory:

    cd wp-content/plugins/proofwp

  3. Install dependencies:

    npm install

  4. Run the build command:

    npm run build

Source files are located in the src/ directory.

What’s Next?

If you like ProofWP, then check out our other WordPress plugins designed to help you increase engagement, conversions, and sales.

ReelsWP – Easily add fast, mobile-friendly vertical video grids and reels carousels to your landing pages, blog posts, news articles, or product pages. Tag products inside videos and create shoppable video experiences.

Marquee Addons – Makes it easy to add smooth marquee effects for text, buttons, images, testimonials, videos, and cards to Elementor websites with continuous scrolling loops for your content.
sections.changelog:
1.0.3 – 2026-05-19

  • Fix: Fixed styling issues affecting some elements.

1.0.2 – 2026-05-18

  • New: Added a Review Reminder page with Pro feature lock.

1.0.1 – 2026-05-17

  • New: Added product tagging support in manual review creation.
  • New: Added Judge.me review import functionality.
  • New: Added verified badges for verified customer reviews.
  • New: Added media upload limitations for manual review submissions.
  • New: Added caching system to improve plugin performance and reduce load times.
  • New: Added Pro feature overlay and unified widget option controls.
  • New: Added dynamic review source filtering to display only sources with available reviews.
  • Fix: Fixed rating rendering issues in review widgets.
  • Fix: Fixed an issue where widgets were not displaying correctly inside custom blocks.
  • Fix: Fixed style scoping issues preventing styles from applying correctly.
  • Tweak: Improved UI consistency and overall user experience across several plugin pages.

1.0.0 – 2026-05-16

  • New: Initial Release.
